key_courses.value: INSE 8901 MASc Research and Thesis (29 cr); 12 cr from INSE topic areas E66 Systems Engineering, E67 3D Graphics & Intelligent Systems, E68 Quality Systems Engineering, E70 Information Systems Engineering; 4 cr Gina Cody courses. No cloud/infrastructure/IT-management courses identified.

eligibility_notes: Provisional: same admission as MEng ('any engineering or science discipline ... appropriate background'); thesis program, funding possible but not guaranteed, no co-op. Curriculum is thesis plus 12 credits from Systems Eng / 3D graphics / Quality Systems / Information Systems Engineering topic areas: little cloud or IT management content, and a research thesis in quality systems is a weak fit for a DevOps career goal. Fall international deadline March 1 (2027 presumably). Tuition UNKNOWN.
